findings.title: Kafka startup prints authentication configuration to stdout
findings.severity: high potential impact; requires log access and usable broker credentials
demonstrated_disclosures: TLS private key, passphrase and PFX bytes
findings.impact_limit: Synthetic output disclosure confirmed. No production exposure or credential reuse tested.
findings.fix: Remove the configuration console.log; preserve the original KafkaConfig object passed to KafkaJS.

duplicate_handoff.instruction: Reference this finding if reviewing the same KafkaConfig startup dump; do not count it twice.

coverage: Every tracked production source file in core, consoleTransport and kafkaTransport
Caller input to scopes, arguments and markers, transport registration, event construction and output
KafkaConfig credential flow, initialization failure, send and close boundaries
Pinned KafkaJS 2.2.4 configuration types, SASL connection/authenticator interfaces, PLAIN failure and TLS socket forwarding
All package manifests, lockfiles, compiler configurations, README, .nvmrc and tracked infrastructure inventory
coverage_gaps: Consuming services, login/session/password reset/MFA implementations and their configurations are absent.
Broker security configuration, ACLs, TLS deployment and network exposure are absent.
Production log access, retention, historical exposure and credential reuse were not inspected.
No live broker handshake or certificate-validation test; dependency source was traced and the wrapper was exercised with an isolated fake Kafka client.
Node 18.14.0 requested by .nvmrc was not exercised; tests ran on Node 24.8.0.
rejected_suspicions: No login/session/authentication endpoint exists in this library.
No wrapper fallback to an anonymous connection after an authentication rejection.
Optional SASL/TLS settings alone do not prove a deployment authentication bypass.
Log content and marker fields do not become Kafka connection credentials.
OAuth callback return tokens are not demonstrated to leak merely by inspecting the callback function.
